Topline data are expected in the second half of 2028.

Additional aleniglipron data expected in the fourth quarter of 2026 include topline results from three supplementary clinical trials designed to build on the Phase 2 findings and further characterize aleniglipron’s clinical profile: · Body composition clinical trial: Results from a 44-week study evaluating the effects of aleniglipron on body fat and overall body composition. · T2DM clinical trial: Results from a 30-week study in adults living with T2DM and obesity or overweight. · SWITCH clinical trial: Results evaluating the transition from an approved injectable GLP-1 receptor agonist to once-daily oral aleniglipron for weight loss maintenance.

Oral Small Molecule Dual Amylin and Calcitonin Receptor Agonists In September 2026, the Company reported topline results from the single ascending dose (SAD) portion of its Phase 1/2a clinical trial of ACCG-2671, an oral small molecule dual amylin and calcitonin receptor agonist (DACRA).
Topline data from the MAD portion are expected in the first half of 2027.
